headline: How Much Higher Can Caterpillar Stock Go From Here?
summary: Shares of Caterpillar (CAT) have fallen 14.8% since reaching a one-month high on October 6, 2026. The decline includes a 5.7% loss on October 7. A Barron's report that day tied the drop in Caterpillar and Deere shares to regulatory pressure, noting the Federal Trade Commission and the Department of Agriculture seek public information on the farm equipment market.
